title: cross-team engineering leadership weekly staff notes - 2026-04-06
content:
Date: 2026-04-06
Facilitator: Sofia Martinez
Notes taken by: Lina Chen
Duration: 45m (09:00 - 09:45 PT)
Location: Zoom / #eng-serv-runtime
Attendees: Sofia Martinez, Lina Chen, Marcus O'Neill, Priya Kapoor, Diego Ramos, Mei Tan, Arjun Singh, Evelyn Park

Agenda:
- Quick wins / highlights
- Cross-team updates (Serving Runtime, Observability, SRE, Platform, Private)
- Blockers & escalations
- Action items and owners
- Parking lot / follow-ups

Quick wins / highlights:
- Shipping the continuous-batching perf optimizer to canary (serving-runtime) - preliminary 12% token-cost improvement on small-seq workloads.
- Tracing v2 rollout (observability) reached 60% of production traffic; basic flame graphs available in Console.
- Two Private pilot customers confirmed for late-April on-prem trial (private-deployments).

Team updates:
1) Serving Runtime (Marcus O'Neill)
- Progress: Canary of batching optimizer deployed to eu-west and us-west canaries. Early telemetry shows expected latency SLOs maintained.
- Risk: Kernel selection change from PR #412 introduced slight memory regression for long-context (~32k) customers. Repro steps and heap snapshots attached in PR discussion.
- Mitigation: Rollback plan ready if we see >3% error-rate or memory pressure OOMs. Marcus to open hotfix branch and coordinate with release-engineering.
- Next: Finish quantization profile tests for Llama-2 variants (target: 2026-04-13).

2) Observability (Priya Kapoor)
- Tracing v2: 60% rollout, initial dashboards in Console. Need feedback on sampling knobs - current default is 1 in 100 for low-latency routes.
- Cost dashboards: New token-level cost breakdown landed; product wants retention increased to 90 days for rollout review. Cost impact estimate: +8% storage cost.
- Action: Priya to present retention-cost tradeoffs in product sync on 2026-04-08.

3) Site Reliability / SRE (Evelyn Park)
- Incident review: 2026-04-02 partial degradation (15m) caused by autoscaler thrash when several burst queues started simultaneously. Root cause: race in scale-up / scale-down timers.
- Postmortem draft circulating (linked in artifacts). Immediate fix: increase cooldown windows and add jitter to scale decisions.
- Long-term: rewrite autoscaler decision logic (tracked ENG-7812).

4) Platform Engineering (Diego Ramos)
- Autoscaling: Working with SRE on a staged rollout of cooldown/jitter change. Need more loadtest scenarios that mimic PLG burst behavior (new testcases needed).
- Dedicated: Preparing capacity forecasts for Q2 reserved pools; ask to Product for commit guidance by 2026-04-14.

5) Private Deployments (Mei Tan)
- Onboarding: Two pilots (finance-corp, healthpilot) scheduled for 2026-04-20 and 2026-04-28.
- KMS/HSM integration: Roadmap item; currently blocked on partner SOC attestation paperwork for customer A. Security is supporting.

Blockers & escalations:
- Memory regression in kernel selection (Serving Runtime) - owner: Marcus O'Neill. If rollback needed, coordinate with Release Eng and SRE. Target decision window: 24 hours if canary shows memory pressure.
- Autoscaler race condition impacting production scale decisions - owner: Evelyn Park / Diego Ramos. Priority: P1 until fix is rolled to canary.
- KMS attestation documents delayed by legal - owner: Mei Tan / Security. Escalate to Legal if not resolved by 2026-04-09.

Action items (owner - due date):
- Marcus: Prepare hotfix branch and memory regression mitigation plan; run focused long-context load tests (due 2026-04-07).
- Priya: Present retention vs cost tradeoff to Product; recommend retention period (due 2026-04-08).
- Evelyn + Diego: Deploy autoscaler cooldown/jitter change to canary and run stress tests; report findings (due 2026-04-09).
- Mei: Confirm KMS paperwork status with Security and Legal; update pilots timeline (due 2026-04-09).
- Lina: Share meeting notes + links to incident postmortem and PR #412 in #eng-serv-runtime (done by EOD 2026-04-06).

Decisions made:
- Hold kernel-selection kernel roll-forward on long-context candidate until hotfix validated.
- Autoscaler cooldown/jitter change approved for canary; canary window = 48h before wider rollout.
- Increase tracing sampling on critical-latency routes to 1 in 50 for one week for additional telemetry; observability to monitor cost impact.

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Sizing study for Dedicated GPU pool (Q3) - Platform to draft capacity model.
- Evaluate adding a memory-pressure alert to Console for customers with >16k context.
- Discuss GA criteria for batching optimizer (metrics and regression thresholds).

Next meeting: 2026-04-13 09:00 PT

Attachments / links referenced in meeting:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/412
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7812
- Postmortem (draft): confluence:Incident 2026-04-02 partial autoscaler degradation (page id: 8290)

Notes / tone: Focused, operational. Meeting ran slightly over due to kernel regression discussion. Action owners committed to timelines above.
